about: The Fractured Archive's lobby in front of the Archive Door, 99 in every combat skill, magic worn and a hybrid inventory for the whole raid.
notes: Testing only, not live content: the raid playtest NPC (RaidTester.kt) starts it, as ::scenario does. The loadout is ours, a guess at a strong all-styles raid setup, as the Wiki's raid page asks for melee, ranged and magic (read 2026-11-16): Ancestral, a Kodai wand and Elidinis' ward (f) worn; a Twisted bow, a Ghrazi rapier and an Avernic defender to switch to, a Dragon warhammer for its special attack, runes for Wind surge (Ezekiel's swords are weak to air) and Fire surge (the Archive Guardian to fire) on the standard spellbook, 4 Saradomin brews, 4 Super restores, a Super combat, a Ranging and a Magic potion, and Manta rays. Dragon arrows are worn in every loadout so the Twisted bow can be switched to. Items by gameval name, which the cache audit (ScenarioCacheAuditTest) checks.
